result.rationale: Verified in diff: totalPages = Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which over-counts when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100/50 → 3 pages instead of 2). Since showingLast is propertyEqual('currentPage','totalPages'), page 2 won't register as last; the 'next' action clamps offset to Math.min(offset+limit, user_count) = user_count, fetching an offset == user_count (empty result) while displaying currentPage == totalPages. Empty 'last' page is reachable exactly as described.

judged_text: Pagination off-by-one: totalPages = Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 is one too high when user_count is an exact multiple of limit, and because showingLast/next/findMembers clamps allow offset == user_count, the admin can navigate to an empty 'last' page (e.g., '3/3' or '2/2' showing an empty member list); clamps should use Math.ceil(user_count / limit) / cap offset at (totalPages-1)*limit, and the same flaw leaves the admin on an empty page after member removals when offset lands on the new user_count
